review.assessment: The change introduces a new `src/lib.rs` file containing the `slugify` function, but leaves it unimplemented with a TODO comment that simply returns an empty string. As a result, both provided unit tests fail because the function does not perform any character normalization or punctuation removal.

findings.actual: Returns an empty string (`""`) for all inputs due to `String::new()` being unconditionally returned.
findings.defect: `slugify` is a stub and does not process the input title into a URL slug.
findings.expected: Tests pass; `slugify("My First Post!")` returns `"my-first-post"` and `slugify("Hello World")` returns `"hello-world"`.
